correctness.rationale: Kummer carry counts and the exact trailing-two decomposition establish the two-state weighted transfer matrix T=[[2,u],[1,2u]], including all-2 and zero-length boundary cases. Resolvent algebra proves the bivariate rational identity for every L; differentiation gives exact moments and dominant-root expansion proves the Gaussian limit and fixed-valuation asymptotics. A separate stdlib program uses Legendre factorial valuations to check 29524 complete index instances through L=9, 10000 independent carry comparisons, and exact rational finite moments. Enumeration is explicitly not treated as proof of the infinite identities.

originality.rationale: The specifically new theorem is the all-level, all-block-length rational census P_L(u), its exact first two moments and its Gaussian law, not the pre-existing individual valuation formula or the residue modulo 3. OEIS A067397 publishes a per-index recurrence; Alter--Kubota addresses prime-power divisibility; Deutsch--Sagan gives Catalan residues modulo 3; Chen--Jiang gives fixed-offset prime-power congruences; Li provides digit valuation formulas. No inspected statement supplies the simultaneous block-length/valuation frequency generating function and its limit law. The missing 1973 full text leaves material priority risk.
residual_risks: Alter--Kubota (1973) full text was unavailable; it may already contain or imply an all-scale distribution beyond its quoted zero-block theorem.

value.rationale: The exact law P_L(u) is a natural complete finite-block census of three-adic divisibility across all levels, stronger than per-index lookup or zero-vs-nonzero counts. The explicit finite mean/variance and central limit theorem reveal the typical valuation scale, while fixed-r asymptotics quantify rare lower-tail frequencies. Such aggregate statistics are mathematically motivated by Kummer carry phenomena and are not arbitrary parameter substitutions or a recomputation of fixed tables.
